item.text: The review found three correctness risks: flat artist folders resolve to their parent, cached artwork does not change when a parent-folder `artist.*` changes, and the new lookup accepts non-image files. The relevant tests passed, so these findings come from the code paths those tests do not exercise.

VERDICT: FIX

CODE DEFECTS
- core/artwork/reader_artist.go:66-73 always takes the parent of the album media directory. For one album stored directly in /music/Artist, artistFolder returns /music, so /music/Artist/artist.jpg is missed. Check the media directory itself when it is the artist directory, and cover this layout.
- core/artwork/reader_artist.go:38-47 derives the artist cache key only from external info and album update times. scanner/refresher.go:100-103 only folds image times from album media dirs into album update time. Adding or replacing /music/Artist/artist.jpg therefore leaves the key unchanged and utils/cache/file_caches.go:109-119 serves the old cached image. Include the artist image timestamp or invalidate the artist key on change.
- core/artwork/reader_artist.go:106-115 accepts any regular artist.* file, including artist.nfo, before image files. Restrict candidates using model.IsImageFile (or image validation) so image fallback remains available.

item.text:
VERDICT: FIX

**Code defects**

- [reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:66) always searches the parent of an album’s media directory. If tracks are stored directly in `/music/Artist`, it misses `/music/Artist/artist.jpg`. Check the media directory as a candidate too.
- [reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:38) leaves the artist cache key unchanged when a parent-folder `artist.*` is added or replaced, so the cache can keep serving the old image. Include that file’s timestamp in invalidation.
- [reader_artist.go](/app/core/artwork/reader_artist.go:106) accepts files such as `artist.nfo` as artwork. Filter candidates with `model.IsImageFile` so valid images and fallbacks remain reachable.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** None.

Tests executed: `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./model ./core/artwork ./scanner ./db/migration` and `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./persistence ./db` passed. The migration package has no tests. `git diff --check` passed.
